actions.name: open_view
actions.description: Open the People view at a path such as /today, /people/{id}, /companies/{id}, /pipelines or /sources. Returns setup state, navigation and a revision. Reads saved records only: it never starts sync or AI. The first preview open seeds fictional records.

actions.name: describe_view_context
actions.description: Describe what the person sees in the People view for the receiving chat: section, filters and up to 50 selected records, each re-resolved under that chat's access. Returns labeled, cited app data within 16 KiB, never raw message bodies or hidden records.

actions.name: create_scope
actions.description: Create the data scope a chat or agent may use in People: chosen accounts, collections and imports, and whether it may read or also write. Opened by Ri's access dialog with the chat bound by the host. The scope takes effect only when Ri saves the grant.

actions.name: list_scopes
actions.description: The data scopes the owner has created for chats and agents, with their sources and operations.

actions.name: revoke_scope
actions.description: Revoke a chat's data scope immediately. Its next request is refused.

actions.name: list_sources
actions.description: Per granted account: kind, granted and automatic state, status, coverage, history range, last success, pending and failed counts and a redacted last error. Also imports, extraction state, held failures, excluded senders, large events and open identity reviews.

actions.name: configure_source
actions.description: Choose an account's history range (30, 90 or 365 days) and, for calendars, which calendars to read. A wider range resumes older backfill only. Never reads a whole mailbox.

actions.name: pause_source
actions.description: Pause or resume updates for one account. Paused accounts keep their records and stop their jobs.

actions.name: delete_source_data
actions.description: Delete what one account or import brought in: conversations, stored text, observed identities, affiliations, facts, suggestions, search rows and briefing caches. Your notes stay and accepted commitments stay as yours. Ri tasks are never touched. Disconnecting is done in Ri and is separate.

actions.name: set_extraction
actions.description: Turn relationship extraction on or pause it. It is off until chosen and separate from read-only sync. On, it sends bounded excerpts of new relevant conversations to Ri's bounded AI to suggest commitments and facts with evidence. Pausing cancels queued work and stops new AI calls.

actions.name: continue_import
actions.description: Run one bounded update step now for one account (or extraction), the same step the schedule runs: one provider page and at most ten new messages, or one extraction batch. Never loops.

actions.name: run_background_step
actions.description: The schedule's single entry point. Recovers interrupted jobs, ensures a job per automatic account, picks the fairest due job (kinds alternate, the account updated longest ago goes first) and runs one bounded step: one sync page or one extraction batch. Returns a short summary.

actions.name: sync_step
actions.description: One bounded mail or calendar sync step for the scheduled caller's accounts.

actions.name: enrich_step
actions.description: One bounded extraction or briefing step for the scheduled caller's accounts.

actions.name: list_exclusions
actions.description: Senders and domains left out: bulk or automated senders counted automatically, your exclusions and inclusions, and suppressed addresses. Each can be changed.

actions.name: save_exclusion
actions.description: Exclude, include or suppress a sender or domain, or clear your decision. Included senders are processed even when their mail looks automated. Decisions persist across syncs.

actions.name: save_collection
actions.description: Create, rename or archive a collection of your own records. Collections are what you can share with a chat separately, such as Work or Family.

actions.name: preview_import
actions.description: Read a selected CSV, vCard or LinkedIn connections export (up to 512 KiB) and plan every row before anything is written: create, update an exact address match, propose a merge for a same-name match, or skip. Shows counts, company matches, the column mapping and unmapped columns. Stores the plan under an expiring preview ID and digest.

output.note: A LinkedIn export is a snapshot. Roles keep their export date and are not treated as current employment. Missing emails are normal.

actions.name: apply_import
actions.description: Apply exactly the stored import plan once, with your row and company decisions. People, companies, affiliations, notes and list memberships are written together. Re-applying returns the first result. Same-name matches are only merged on rows you chose.

actions.name: export_records
actions.description: One part of a scoped owner export: CSV tables for people, companies, affiliations, lists, opportunities, stages and stage history, and JSON for notes, evidence references and decisions. Each part has stable IDs and a format version and ends at a record boundary. A filtered view exports only what it shows. Message bodies are never exported. This is not a full backup.

actions.name: save_navigation
actions.description: Add or hide the Companies and Pipelines views, pin or unpin saved views, and choose the landing view. Navigation only: records, grants, sync and task links are unchanged.

actions.name: list_people
actions.description: List people in the directory with structured filters, a sort and a page cursor. Filters combine with AND, several values in one field mean OR. Results, counts and sort keys use only records this caller may see. A saved view or list can be named instead of filters.

actions.name: save_affiliation

actions.name: list_lists
actions.description: Named lists of people or companies, with member counts this caller may see. A list holds one record kind and is not a permission container.

actions.name: save_list
actions.description: Create a list of people or of companies, or rename or archive one. Archiving keeps memberships and records.

actions.name: update_list_members
actions.description: Add, remove or reorder members of one list (at most 50 per change). Members must be visible records of the list's kind. Membership copies nothing and shares nothing.

actions.name: bulk_update_records
actions.description: Apply one change (pin, archive, add to list or remove from list) to at most 50 selected records, each with its expected revision. Failures are reported per record. There is no select-all across a query and no outreach.

actions.name: list_pipelines
actions.description: Optional pipelines with their ordered stages and the number of opportunities in each that this caller may see. Values are never summed.

actions.name: save_pipeline
actions.description: Create a pipeline from editable stage suggestions (client work, introductions or blank), or rename or archive one. Archiving keeps opportunities and their follow-ups. Pipeline structure is the owner's choice.

actions.name: save_pipeline_stages
actions.description: Rename, add, reorder or remove stages by stable ID with one revision check. A stage holding opportunities can only be removed with a replacement stage, and each move is recorded in stage history.

actions.name: list_opportunities
actions.description: Opportunities for a board or table, filtered by pipeline, stage, company, person or text, with the same query for both layouts. Values are shown per opportunity in their own currency and never added together.

coverage.summary: Checked Personal Gmail (mail, 2026-07-17 to 2026-10-15). Relationship extraction is off.

actions.name: get_opportunity
actions.description: Read one opportunity with its stages, append-only stage history, notes, evidence-backed stage suggestions and linked activity.

actions.name: save_opportunity
actions.description: Create an opportunity in a pipeline, or edit its title, company, people, next action, target date, value or archive state. Value and currency are both set or both absent. Use move_opportunity to change stage or pipeline.

actions.name: move_opportunity
actions.description: Move an opportunity to a stage by stable stage ID, optionally into another pipeline with a destination stage. The revision check stops concurrent moves. History records who moved it and when. Moving never sends a message or completes a task.

actions.name: resolve_identity
actions.description: Decide an identity review: keep two records separate (remembered, never proposed again), accept or reject an address seen in a signature, or include or keep out an incoming-only sender. Accepting can record a company and role in the same step. Merges use merge_people or merge_organizations.

actions.name: merge_people
actions.description: Merge two people after review. Every moved reference is recorded so undo can restore it, and the merged record and its evidence are retained. If either record changed since review, nothing is merged.

actions.name: merge_organizations
actions.description: Merge two companies after review, with the same recorded reference moves and undo as people. A shared name or domain alone is never treated as proof.

output.message: One of these records changed since you reviewed it. Nothing was merged. Review again

actions.name: undo_merge
actions.description: Preview or apply an undo. The preview lists the references to restore and any added after the merge, which you attribute to one record or the other. Applying restores exactly the recorded references, or fails without changes if anything moved since the preview.

laterReferences.label: Note: Ask how the design and research teams work together.

actions.name: delete_record
actions.description: Archive or remove a person or company. Remove deletes imported details and links, keeps conversations in their sources, and either keeps your notes on an archived record or deletes them. Suppress stops rediscovery of its addresses until you clear it in Sources. Ri tasks and a company's people are never deleted.

workflows.name: prepare-for-a-meeting
workflows.description: Prepare the user for a meeting or conversation with someone they know, using this app's permitted records with citations. Use when they ask to get ready for, or catch up before, talking to a person or company.

workflows.name: review-follow-ups
workflows.description: Review what the user owes people, what they are waiting on and the suggested commitments in this app, and help them choose follow-ups. Use when they ask what they promised someone, what is outstanding, or to turn a commitment into a task.
